title: Zero-ordinate projection as a TTI splice and horizontal residue

verdict.conclusion: functional inversion followed by conjugation is the reflection across the critical line; its orthogonal splice separates every upper zero pair into an ordinate channel and a horizontal residue, whose central weighted norm is nonnegative and vanishes exactly under RH, while the full time-domain correction remains signed

centeredZeroGeometry.conjugation: C(z)=conj(z), induced by real xi coefficients

spliceInterpretation.normalizedHadamardSplice: q=(z+S z)/sqrt(2)=sqrt(2) i gamma; r=(z-S z)/sqrt(2)=sqrt(2) eta
spliceInterpretation.warning: F_3=2 matches the two upper members structurally, but TTI arithmetic does not derive the zeta quartet from that count

centralHorizontalResidue.zeroCountingEquivalent: H_ord'(0)=4 integral_0^infinity N(T)/T^3 dT; equality with (log xi)''(1/2) is equivalent to RH
properties: the sum vanishes if and only if every eta is zero
therefore the central residue vanishes if and only if RH
